title: 10 Best HR Help Desk Software Platforms for 2027
summary: Compare 10 HR help desk software platforms for 2027, including features, pricing, and tools for managing employee support requests.
body_markdown:
HR teams manage a wide range of employee requests, from payroll questions and benefits enrollment to PTO tracking, onboarding tasks, policy clarifications, and sensitive employee relations matters. When these requests arrive through scattered Slack DMs, email threads, and informal conversations, tracking ownership, progress, and resolution can become more challenging.


An organized HR support process helps teams manage employee requests efficiently while maintaining privacy and accountability. A dedicated[HR service desk](https://unthread.io/solutions/hr-service-desk?ref=unthread.io) provides structured ticketing, clear ownership, SLA tracking, and knowledge management to support consistent employee service.


This guide covers 10 of the best HR help desk software options for 2027, from Slack-native platforms with purpose-built AI agents to enterprise service management systems.


## **Key Takeaways**


- HR teams should prioritize help desk software that supports private employee requests, structured ticket ownership, intelligent routing, workflow automation, and actionable reporting.
- [Unthread](https://unthread.io/?ref=unthread.io) is the recommended option for HR teams that want Slack-native intake, private request handling, and purpose-built AI agent automation across HR and adjacent internal teams like IT, finance, and legal.
- Enterprise HR teams should consider help desk software that supports ITSM governance, cross-department workflows, and integration with existing enterprise systems.
- HR help desk platforms can support HRIS integration and employee relations case management, helping teams manage employee data and sensitive requests.
- An effective HR support setup keeps simple questions easy to submit while moving sensitive requests into private ticketing flows with full audit trails.
- A Slack-native approach simplifies request submission and allows employees to access HR support within their existing workspace.


## **What HR Teams Should Look for in HR Help Desk Software**


HR support differs fundamentally from customer service or general IT ticketing. A benefits question, parental leave discussion, payroll discrepancy, or employee relations issue requires more privacy and sensitivity than a standard software access request. At the same time, employees expect fast answers from the channels where they already work.


A strong HR help desk should help teams:


- Convert messages from Slack, email, and internal portals into structured tickets
- Route requests by topic, team, urgency, or employee context
- Keep sensitive matters private with restricted access controls
- Automate recurring Tier 1 questions through[purpose-built AI agents](https://unthread.io/products/agentic-ai?ref=unthread.io)
- Build a reusable[knowledge base](https://unthread.io/products/knowledge-base?ref=unthread.io) from resolved requests
- Track SLAs and ownership across HR queues
- Connect with HRIS, identity, ITSM, and internal operations tools through relevant[integrations](https://unthread.io/products/integrations?ref=unthread.io)


The most practical systems let HR teams keep everyday request intake simple while adding structure behind the scenes.


## **1) Unthread: Purpose-Built AI Agent for Slack-Native HR Support**


[Unthread](https://unthread.io/?ref=unthread.io) turns Slack, Microsoft Teams, employee portals, and email into a structured internal help desk for HR and cross-functional employee support. It is built for internal teams that need privacy, routing, ticket ownership, reporting, and automation without forcing employees into a separate help desk portal.


### **Why It Fits HR Teams**


Unthread is designed for internal support workflows across HR, IT, finance, procurement, legal, and workplace operations. For HR teams, that means employees can ask about payroll, benefits, leave, employee documents, policy questions, onboarding, and offboarding directly in Slack while HR keeps the work organized and private.


A channel such as #hr-help can become a full internal help desk. General questions can stay in-channel when appropriate, while sensitive matters can move into private workflows for confidentiality. At Lemonade, Unthread automatically resolves approximately[40% of incoming tickets](https://unthread.io/blog/case-study-how-lemonade-boosts-efficiency-with-unthread-and-gen-ai/) across different internal teams, demonstrating its ability to automate routine employee support requests.


### **HR-Relevant Capabilities**


- [Purpose-built AI agents](https://unthread.io/products/agentic-ai?ref=unthread.io) for triage, routing, and resolution support
- [Private ticketing for HR teams](https://unthread.io/solutions/hr-service-desk?ref=unthread.io) handling payroll, benefits, leave, employee documents, and policy questions
- [Workflow automations](https://unthread.io/products/automations?ref=unthread.io) for recurring Tier 1 requests, approvals, escalations, and follow-ups, with advanced automation capabilities available through eligible plans
- Self-learning[knowledge management](https://unthread.io/products/knowledge-base?ref=unthread.io) that turns repeated employee questions into reusable documentation
- [AI analytics](https://unthread.io/products/analytics?ref=unthread.io) for identifying request trends, bottlenecks, and automation opportunities
- [SOC 2 Type II compliance](https://unthread.io/security?ref=unthread.io) and HIPAA compliance with BAAs on Enterprise plans


Unthread is also useful when HR works closely with IT, finance, procurement, legal, and workplace operations. A single employee request often crosses team boundaries, such as onboarding, equipment, system access, payroll setup, and policy acknowledgement. Unthread helps those handoffs stay structured while keeping the employee experience simple.


### **What HR Should Consider**


Unthread is the clearest fit when Slack or Microsoft Teams is already a primary employee workspace and HR wants to reduce manual triage without adding another place for employees to check. Teams can evaluate Unthread through a[14-day free trial](https://unthread.io/pricing?ref=unthread.io) , with agent-based subscription plans and custom options for organizations requiring advanced automation, integrations, and enterprise security.


## **2) ServiceNow HR Service Delivery**


ServiceNow HR Service Delivery is an enterprise HR service management platform for large organizations with complex employee service, compliance, and workflow requirements.


### **Where It Fits**


ServiceNow HRSD is often considered when HR service delivery needs to operate across multiple regions, policies, approval chains, and enterprise systems. The platform is a practical consideration for companies with established ServiceNow environments and dedicated platform administration.


### **HR-Relevant Capabilities**


- Employee service center and HR case management
- Now Assist AI for automated responses and virtual agents
- Workflow design for approvals, routing, and escalations
- Knowledge management for employee self-service
- Role-based controls for sensitive employee information


## **3) Freshservice by Freshworks**


Freshservice is Freshworks' IT service management platform and is often evaluated by internal teams that want structured service desk workflows.


### **Where It Fits**


Freshservice is relevant for organizations where HR support overlaps with IT service management, onboarding workflows, employee assets, and internal service catalogs. It can support internal support operations where IT owns many employee-facing service processes.


### **HR-Relevant Capabilities**


- Service catalog with workflow orchestration across HR, IT, Finance, and Admin
- Freddy AI Copilot provides response suggestions and ticket summarization
- Visual workflow builder for complex multi-step processes like onboarding
- Knowledge base and self-service options


## **4) Jira Service Management**


Jira Service Management, together with Atlassian Assist, supports conversational ticketing for teams already using Atlassian tools.


### **Where It Fits**


This option is most relevant when HR requests need to connect with Jira Service Management or when the company already uses Atlassian for IT, operations, and knowledge management.


### **HR-Relevant Capabilities**


- Slack and Teams request intake connected to Jira Service Management
- Pre-built HR templates for onboarding, payroll, and general inquiries
- Customizable workflow engine for complex multi-step HR processes
- Knowledge management through Confluence


## **5) Zendesk**


Zendesk is a broad service platform that some organizations adapt for internal HR help desk operations.


### **Where It Fits**


Zendesk is often evaluated when a company already uses it for service workflows and wants to extend similar ticketing practices to HR. It can support multi-channel intake, routing, knowledge base content, and reporting.


### **HR-Relevant Capabilities**


- AI Agents for ticket deflection and instant answers to routine HR questions
- Omnichannel ticketing consolidates requests from email, Slack, Teams, chat, and web portal
- Workflow rules, SLAs, and routing
- Marketplace integrations including major HRIS platforms


## **6) Hiver**


Hiver is a Gmail-based shared inbox and ticketing platform for teams working in Google Workspace.


### **Where It Fits**


Hiver is an option for HR teams that operate primarily in Gmail. It allows HR staff to convert emails into tickets, collaborate on responses, and track ownership without leaving their inbox.


### **HR-Relevant Capabilities**


- Native Gmail integration where the entire helpdesk operates inside Gmail
- AI Copilot provides contextual response suggestions and auto-summarizes conversations
- Multi-channel support from a single dashboard
- Basic configuration takes 10 minutes


## **7) HappyFox Help Desk**


HappyFox provides multi-channel HR ticketing with a focus on clean user experience and workflow automation.


### **Where It Fits**


HappyFox is relevant for mid-market HR teams that want consolidated request handling across email, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and web portals.


### **HR-Relevant Capabilities**


- Smart Rules automation for complex ticket routing and escalation workflows
- Multi-channel support from a single dashboard
- Built-in asset management for tracking IT inventory alongside HR requests
- Unlimited-agent pricing plans available with a flat-rate model


## **8) Zoho Desk**


Zoho Desk is a help desk platform that integrates with other products in the Zoho ecosystem.


### **Where It Fits**


Zoho Desk is relevant for organizations using Zoho People (HRIS) or other Zoho products. It offers enterprise features across multiple pricing tiers.


### **HR-Relevant Capabilities**


- Blueprint workflow engine enforces step-by-step HR processes with mandatory approvals
- Zia AI assistant provides sentiment analysis, suggested responses, and ticket tagging
- Deep native integration with Zoho People and broader Zoho ecosystem
- Free tier with help desk features


## **9) BambooHR**


BambooHR is an all-in-one HRIS with built-in HR help desk capabilities for employee self-service.


### **Where It Fits**


BambooHR is relevant for organizations that want HRIS functionality alongside employee request handling, including SMBs establishing their first formal HR processes.


### **HR-Relevant Capabilities**


- Employee self-service portal integrated with core HRIS data (PTO, benefits, documents)
- Ask BambooHR AI assistant answers policy questions with cited sources
- Workflow automation for onboarding, time-off requests, and document approvals
- Integrated HRIS and employee self-service functionality within one platform


## **10) Dovetail Software**


Dovetail Software provides HR case management for teams handling employee relations and compliance-heavy HR processes.


### **Where It Fits**


Dovetail is relevant for HR teams that need structured case management for employee relations, grievances, disciplinary matters, and accommodations. It is more case-management oriented than general Slack ticketing.


### **HR-Relevant Capabilities**


- Purpose-built employee relations workflows for grievances, disciplinary cases, investigations
- Full audit trails and GDPR compliance features built-in
- Integrations with Workday, SAP, BambooHR, ADP, and major HRIS platforms
- Configurable workflows for regulated HR processes

## **Frequently Asked Questions**


### **What is the primary benefit of using AI in HR help desk software?**


AI helps HR teams reduce manual work by automatically routing requests, suggesting responses, and resolving routine employee questions.[Purpose-built AI agents](https://unthread.io/products/agentic-ai?ref=unthread.io) can use existing knowledge to provide context-aware answers, assist with ticket triage, and escalate complex issues to the appropriate HR staff. This allows teams to spend more time on sensitive employee matters while improving response consistency.


### **How does a Slack-native HR help desk improve employee experience?**


A Slack-native HR help desk allows employees to submit requests and receive updates directly within their existing workspace. With Unthread's[Slack-native ticketing](https://unthread.io/products/slack-support?ref=unthread.io) , employee messages can become structured tickets with assigned owners, priorities, and SLA tracking. HR teams can manage requests efficiently while keeping sensitive conversations private through dedicated ticketing workflows.


### **Can HR help desk software integrate with our existing HRIS?**


HR help desk platforms can connect with HRIS systems through native integrations, APIs, or automation workflows. Unthread offers[integrations with business tools](https://unthread.io/products/integrations?ref=unthread.io) that help teams connect employee support with existing HR and operational systems. Depending on the integration and configuration, these connections can support employee data access, request routing, and automated workflows across departments.


### **How can a self-learning knowledge base benefit my HR team?**


A self-learning knowledge base helps HR teams organize information from recurring employee questions and resolved requests. Unthread's[AI-powered knowledge base](https://unthread.io/products/knowledge-base?ref=unthread.io) supports knowledge creation and maintenance, making it easier to provide consistent answers to common questions about benefits, leave policies, and onboarding. This reduces repetitive work and helps employees access relevant information more efficiently.
